scope: Profile-led v2 execution experiment. The emitted frame, ratio, parser validation rules, independent blocks and public safe decode API are unchanged. This is directional/smoke evidence, not all-Q95 target qualification.

profile_trigger.interpretation: The original variable-size non-overlap branch spent about 58.85% of sampled stacks in platform_memmove, motivating only the proven-disjoint 8..=63-byte replacement.

json_16mib_reversed_order.configuration: one worker, 64 KiB blocks, Neon, checksums off, nine 0.2-second samples

validated_replay_follow_up.note: Validated replay remains a separate diagnostic and is not substituted for safe decode.

q95_smoke.policy: Manifest-verified eight-member serial one-process smoke; each frame roundtrips through the safe public decode path.

decision: Retain the bounded helper: it is byte-exact, bounded to a profile-dominant, already-proven non-overlap range, and wins in both execution orders. Do not claim the 4/95/15 target: JSON remains below 10 GB/s and 1.20x LZ4, held-out Q95 members remain much slower, and the unchanged artifact ratios still fail the hard gate.
